technical.summary: IBM shows strong long-term bullish structure with golden cross and trend confirmation, but extreme overbought conditions across all momentum oscillators and stochastic bearish cross signal elevated pullback risk; entry timing is poor despite bullish technicals.

fundamental.summary: IBM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 20 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 purchases by junior members in small-to-medium amounts) with neutral broad market sentiment and no recent news data provides insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (286) combined with earnings binary in 20 days creates severe near-term risk; normal yield curve provides limited offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross with EMA 50/200, ADX trend confirmation, and price above all major moving averages establish strong long-term bullish structure with institutional accumulation signal.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions across RSI-9 (97.38), RSI-14 (92.59), stochastic bearish cross, compressed Bollinger Bands (0.1561), VIX crisis regime (286), and earnings binary in 20 days create severe pullback/gap-down risk with poor entry timing despite bullish setup.
